body.asks: Whether an act's line stays flat as today, at, blocks, gone and says, with predecessor for parent, and its content hash worked out from those four alone rather than written beside them.

How a line says which of an act's blocks are this store's: an own list of their hashes, written whenever the act touched another store, by blocks or by gone alone, own: [] apart from absent; the act's blocks listed once each, by hash, so its content hash never depends on order.

Whether a store's table keeps each block's count of new holons, so it may hold an id only within its own run, with whether a moment is taken a check of its own for minting; old entries without a count read by their moment.

name: A store holds only its own runs

body.asks: That a holon kept in two stores has its new version written in each, each line with its own store's prev, so one act writes different blocks for one holon and the content hash covers them all.

name: One holon's version in two stores

body.asks: That the format writes an act to the stores it is given, each with the holons it keeps, blocks then lines then refs; in each store the new holons are its own run and the rest arrive as moved with no prev; which store keeps what is the engine's.

name: What the format's act is given
